scope: Research full-ring homemade BGV/GMP/existing single-thread public C++ NTT plus isolated private-check C++. No SEAL/GPU. Private checking before secret decryption, trusted index/offline answers, pinned requests, one-use local tokens and bounded verification transcript. Existing HE absolute phase/key gates unchanged. All four gates verify the same canonical response; totals are paired measured stage-sum ablations. No production, private-timing, RLWE assurance, malicious-preprocessing or full adaptive privacy proof. Coefficient bodies exclude framing/authentication; all diagnostics/reference comparisons outside timing. Polynomial hashing is a known family, not a novelty claim; vector native control preserves the exact old family.
